concept: A curved silver suture needle and looping cream thread form a bold S.
A cream clock uses short sutures to bridge its two bold hands.
A sage heart with a cream stitch seam makes care feel handmade.
A cozy clinic facade uses cream walls, olive trim and welcoming planters.
A single silver scalpel sits diagonally on clinic green.
A stethoscope's round loop doubles as a clock face.
A diagonal plaster has an oversized stitched center pad.
The existing Rounds Doctor founder appears as a white-coat bust.
The game's olive exam bed has a fresh cream paper roll.
A cream medical plus is joined by a visible stitch seam.
A thread loop winds around a chunky hourglass.
An olive thread spool leaves a loose cream loop and needle.
A chunky ST monogram carries one unmistakable stitch seam.
A top-down clinic floor plan groups rooms around a clear central corridor.
A cream clipboard carries a bold stitched-heart chart symbol.
A sage surgical mask uses clean cream loops and a stitched center.
A clinic key has a clock-shaped bow and one dangling stitch loop.
Open surgical scissors echo a clock's two hands.
A tired coffee mug wears a small clock badge.
A surgical needle and thick thread form an infinity loop.
